_comment: What the scan never prints (ACP-449). A value is replaced by the replacement text wherever the scan renders it: the confirmation listing, the terminal report, the --json document and every finding. flag_words: a flag or variable NAME containing one of these words (case-insensitive) has its value replaced, in '--name=value', '--name value', 'NAME=value' and 'Name: value'. value_prefixes: regular-expression fragments; a value that STARTS with one is replaced wherever it appears, flag or not. Every environment variable a server's configuration declares has its value replaced unconditionally, so the environment needs no rule here. The real values are still read and passed to a server the person approved; only what is printed changes.
